answer_1.quote: Text simplification aims to improve a text's readability or content accessibility while preserving its fundamental meaning.

answer_2.quote: We consider five automatic metrics: BLEU, SARI, the most widely-used text simplification metric, BERTSCORE, COMET-MQM, a machine translation metric trained on MQM ratings, and LENS, a recently proposed text simplification metric finetuned on SIMPEVAL that contains rank-based human ratings of simplifications from 24 systems.

answer_4.quote: we hire 6 undergraduate students from a US university. Annotators were trained with an in-depth tutorial consisting of broad explanations of simplification concepts, over 100 examples covering each of the 21 SALSA edit types and interactive exercises, completed two rounds of onboarding annotations and were provided continuous feedback by the authors.
answer_4.guideline: The annotation process consists of (1) selecting edits, (2) identifying information change, (3) classifying edit type and (4) rating efficacy/severity.
